title: Steward goal refused: token re-prompt, then 'Unknown endpoint' - nothing created
body:
John 2026-07-30 (project-level steward chamber, then the main dashboard High Seat):

1st report: "I thought that we got the steward up and working, but when I tried to enter a goal into a project level steward it did not let me. Instead it asked for a token again (which it had stored in the window). I suspect that the same thing happens when I try and use the steward in the main Anchor Dashboard."

2nd report (after the token fix): "When I tried to set a goal, I did not get a problem with the token, but I did get the following error: Couldn't do that: Unknown endpoint - nothing was created."

THREE independent faults, all only reachable with auth ON:
(a) the steward POSTs sent the token as ?token= only; do_POST reads X-Anchor-Token / Authorization / body token and NEVER the query -> 401 -> the global 401 wrapper re-prompted for a token the window already held. This is also the un-fixed ROOT of the 2026-07-28 High Seat friction record, which treated the reload symptom but not the 401 cause.
(b) handle_ecgberht_stand_up was defined and declared migrated=True in route_table, but was never registered in _MIGRATED_HANDLERS; _strangler_dispatch falls through on an unregistered handler and the legacy chain answers 404 'Unknown endpoint'. handle_friction_list and handle_journal_friction had the identical omission (found by the new gate) and were dead 404s too.
(c) do_POST dispatched on the RAW request line while do_GET passes path-only; route_table.match compares an EXACT row with path == pattern, so ANY POST carrying a query missed its row.

WHY THE SUITE WAS GREEN OVER A BROKEN DASHBOARD: with ANCHOR_TOKEN unset, _tokenQ() is empty and every one of these faults disappears. Virtually the whole suite runs auth-OFF.

FIXED + GATED 2026-07-30: token rides the X-Anchor-Token header, bare POST paths, the missing registrations added, do_POST dispatches on the path, plus a new auth-ON suite (tests/test_steward_goal_authon_2026_07_30.py) that sets a goal in a real browser and asserts ECGBERHT.md + strip.json land on disk with the North Star verbatim.

context.surface: project window steward chamber (stand_up) + main dashboard High Seat (high_seat_act)
